name: AionUi Open-Source Desktop AI Agent Workspace
free_limit: Apache-2.0 desktop cowork and AI-agent interface for macOS, Windows and Linux with local file workflows and support for connecting external or local AI agents; no license fee for the open-source app.
watch_out: Model subscriptions, API tokens, third-party coding agents and remote hosting may incur charges; the app does not grant free paid LLM inference. Grant filesystem and shell permissions carefully because connected agents can execute local operations.
